title: Make SRD importer self-auditing against source PDF
description:
Problem

The SRD importer has no open tracked issues, but the latest manual audit shows the pack is not yet complete or accurately bounded against the source PDF. The importer has made real progress, but remaining failures are now systemic rather than isolated row omissions.

Observed audit facts

- The current generated pack has about 1,650 records.
- verify:dnd5e-srd-pack, check, typecheck, and tests pass.
- The audit bundle metadata still reported srdStructureAudit.hasFindings: true.
- The pack captures broad SRD content, but much of it is flattened into descriptions rather than represented as usable structured records.
- Some source boundaries are still wrong: subclass records swallow feature text, and Feather Token swallows Figurine of Wondrous Power.
- Some document-scoped structures are missed: embedded stat blocks such as Avatar of Death and Giant Fly are not emitted as creature-like records.
- Creature records are skeletal compared with SRD stat blocks.
- Class records omit class skill choices, tool proficiencies, starting equipment options, spellcasting progression, and class progression tables.
- Many source tables are missing as table records or structured child data.

Goal

Make the SRD importer self-auditing against the source PDF so future audits do not rely on manual archaeology. Every source heading, table, stat block, and structured rules object in the SRD should be accounted for as one of:

1. an emitted top-level record,
2. structured child data on an emitted record,
3. an intentionally ignored source item with an explicit reason.

Non-goals

- Do not hand-author canonical SRD pack content.
- Do not weaken current pack verification or regression tests.
- Do not claim source coverage based only on flattened prose when the source content is structured and needed for play.
- Do not opportunistically rewrite unrelated importer code without failing tests or audit findings motivating the change.

Agent instructions

Work in red/green slices. For every parser or schema fix, add or update source-backed tests first. Prefer deterministic extraction from the vendored PDF text/coordinate artifacts. Preserve source provenance and fail closed when expected source structures disappear or parse ambiguously.

Relevant areas to inspect

- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1
- generated SRD pack records.json
- vendored SRD PDF and extracted pdf-text/page artifacts
- current SRD structure audit reports
- pack verification tests and importer pipeline tests

Completion criteria

- The child beads under this epic are complete.
- The importer has a deterministic source-structure coverage gate.
- Known audit findings are either fixed or represented as explicit expected gaps with rationale.
- A fresh audit bundle no longer reports untracked source content that should have records.
notes: Claude independent review 2026-06-11: epic verified against the generated pack and audit bundle; all headline claims confirmed (feather-token swallows Figurine of Wondrous Power + Giant Fly stat block; no figurine/avatar-of-death/giant-fly records; creature:aboleth has only header stats — no saves/skills/senses/traits/actions/legendary actions; class:barbarian lacks skills/tools/equipment/progression; 29 table records exist but no class progression or draconic-ancestry tables; all 12 subclasses swallow feature bodies per srd-structure-audit). Dependency edges added 2026-06-11 to encode execution order: 4a7.1 gates 2/3/4; 4a7.5 needs 4; 4a7.6 needs 2+3; 4a7.7 needs 3; 4a7.8 needs 2+3+4; 4a7.9 needs all. Recommended execution order: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 (or 8 before 5-7 — any topological order works). NOTE: 4a7.3 (document-wide tables) and 4a7.5 (full stat blocks for 317 creatures) are large; expect them to be split into sub-slices (.3a/.3b style or child beads) during execution rather than landing as single PRs. All children must follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.
